alignments.note: Anarthrous Greek noun with a supplied determiner: the determiner is a rule 7 helper on the noun it determines (rule 51).
Case preposition rides with the noun; rule 17 heads a source noun rendered by of + noun on the noun.

Denominal verb rendered by the discontinuous frame turning ... into ashes (rule 15). Rule 17's meaning-bearing complement heads it on ashes, the word realizing the lexeme; a head on turning remains defensible.
Case preposition and supplied determiner ride with the anarthrous noun (rules 21, 51).
Supplied English object stays with the verb that requires it (rule 74).

The participle is rendered as a finite relative clause; relativizer and modal are helpers and rule 9 heads it on the lexical verb live. The ASV appears to follow a reading with the infinitive, so the split of live against ungodly between this token and s011 is defensible either way.

Substantival adjective with its case preposition and supplied nominal, discontinuous around the relative clause under rule 15; rule 17 heads it on ungodly, the adjective's own English word, rather than on the supplied those.
Auxiliary and supplied object ride with the participle; rule 9 heads it on the lexical verb.
